description: The troll smith Ula'elek will craft for you the brutal gauntlets.  He dwells in Durotar, in Sen'jin Village with his Darkspear brethren, and he awaits your coming.
completion: Greetings, <name>.  Old Thun'grim sent word to me of your coming, but had he kept silent your presence here would not have surprised me.
The spirits follow your progress, young warrior, and they tell me that many foes have fallen before you.
